policies.title: Panama: Syrian ordinary passports
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Syria in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring consular filing and approval before travel for visitors without the separate third-country-document waiver.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Syrian passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The Embassy says the authorized-visa applicant must appear in person at the consulate; approval may take up to 60 business days and travel should not be finalized before grant.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, invitation and final-admission treatment are not classified by this policy.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on verification and document completion.
steps: Determine that the separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Appear in person at the competent Panamanian consulate with the required authorized-visa application documents.
Do not finalize travel arrangements until the authorized visa has been granted.
